content.short: Rivo.xyz is a multichain smart-contract wallet with a DeFi marketplace for earning with DeFi in one click.
content.description: Rivo.xyz is a smart-contract wallet powered by account abstraction that lets you set up your wallet without a seed phrase, perform cross-chain swaps, and invest with any token directly within the platform. It provides enhanced security and lets you pay gas with any token. Rivo also features a DeFi Marketplace, a hub with leading TVL protocols, risk-adjusted strategies, tutorials on applying these strategies, advanced portfolio analytics and PnL tracking, and market reports to monitor crypto trends.
